fieldValues.title: Lifecycle
fieldValues.extension_adds: `Lifecycle`: an installable, referenceable container of `LifecycleState`s and `LifecycleTransition`s, fully integrated with the vocabulary substrate (RFC-006) as a `VocabularyEntry` specialisation. Required for governance tools, decision logs, and any implementation where records progress through defined states.
fieldValues.extension_cost_of_non_adoption: Without it, a record has no defined-state progression to govern: no installable `Lifecycle` container, no `LifecycleState`/`LifecycleTransition` vocabulary, and no state machine for governance tooling or decision logs to drive off.

sourceRefs.note: Extension ext:lifecycle from srs-spec.md - coarse source anchoring during migration
